Specify how many times the video should be rendered during a benchmark. Default `3`.

## CLI flag

Use `--runs` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                     | Flag             |
| ------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark) | `--runs <value>` |
